description: Source code for a server module managing MCP (Model Context Protocol) server instances, including backend creation, request handling, heartbeat management, and server startup.

classes.name: BackendManager
classes.description: Manages creation and disposal of server backends.

classes.name: ServerBackendFactory
classes.description: Factory for creating server backend instances.

methods.name: createBackend
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new backend instance.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects a backend factory to a transport, optionally running heartbeat.

methods.name: createServer
methods.description: Creates an MCP server with request handlers for listing tools and calling tools.

methods.name: initializeServer
methods.description: Initializes server with client capabilities and roots, creates backend.

methods.name: startHeartbeat
methods.description: Starts periodic ping to keep server alive, closes server on timeout.

methods.name: addServerListener
methods.description: Adds event listeners to server for 'close' or 'initialized' events.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts MCP server with HTTP or stdio transport based on options.

methods.name: firstRootPath
methods.description: Returns the first root path from a list of roots.

methods.name: allRootPaths
methods.description: Returns all root paths from a list of roots.

methods.name: mergeTextParts
methods.description: Merges consecutive text parts in a CallToolResult into a single text block.
